checks.label: Rooms inside the building outline
checks.detail: All rooms strictly inside boundary (required: 100% room containment inside boundary polygon)

checks.label: No overlapping rooms
checks.source: Building Code Architectural Separation & 2D Interval Disjointness

checks.label: Door clear widths
checks.detail: All 7 doors meet required clear width (>= 915mm clinical, >= 815mm general) (required: >= 815mm general; >= 915mm exam/patient doors)
checks.source: ADA Accessibility Standards, Chapter 4 §404.2.3 Clear Width

checks.label: Corridor width
checks.detail: Corridor width: 2000mm >= 1830mm (required: >= 1830mm (72 in) for outpatient clinic primary circulation)
checks.source: ADA Accessibility Standards §403.5.1 / VA Space Planning Criteria

checks.label: Wheelchair turning space
checks.detail: All accessible rooms accommodate 1525mm diameter turning circle (required: >= 1525mm (60 in) clear diameter; >= 2150mm min dim for single-user ADA restroom)
checks.source: ADA Accessibility Standards, Chapter 3 §304.3 Turning Space

checks.label: Exam room size
checks.detail: All 2 exam rooms exceed 11.15 m2 and 3048mm minimum dimension (required: Area >= 11.15 m2 (120 sq ft) and min dimension >= 3048mm (10 ft))
checks.source: FGI Guidelines for Design and Construction of Outpatient Facilities, §2.1-2.2

checks.label: Clean and soiled utility separation
checks.detail: Strict physical separation maintained between clean and soiled utilities (required: Clean and soiled utility rooms must have strict physical door separation)
checks.source: FGI Guidelines Section 2.1-3 Support Areas & Infection Prevention

checks.label: Every room reachable from an exit
checks.detail: 100% of rooms reachable via BFS door traversal (required: 100% of rooms must be reachable from exterior exit (OUTSIDE))
checks.source: IBC Chapter 10 / NFPA-101 Means of Egress Reachability

checks.label: Exit travel distance
checks.detail: Max travel distance 24900mm <= 45,720mm limit (required: <= 45,720mm (150 ft unsprinklered) or <= 60,960mm (200 ft sprinklered))
checks.source: IBC Table 1017.2 / NFPA-101 Exit Access Travel Distance

provenance.validation_summary: Passed 9 of 9 implemented geometry and code checks; MEP, fire-resistance ratings, and acoustic STC requirements were not evaluated.
